intro: Imagine a table that holds your morning coffee, your favorite books, and still looks stunning—Diante’s dual-side storage and elegant design make life easier and spaces more refined.

features.title: Stylish marble look that lasts
features.text: Turn heads with a bold marble-inspired design that blends timeless elegance with everyday practicality.

features.title: Grab what you need from either side
features.text: Double-sided storage ensures everything stays organised and easily accessible, keeping your home tidy and welcoming.

features.title: Spacious top for work or display
features.text: Whether you’re working, dining, or showcasing décor, the spacious top offers ample room to spread out, stay organised, and make every moment more comfortable and convenient.

features.title: Glossy finish resists everyday scratches
features.text: Scratches and scuffs don’t stand a chance with our durable, scratch-resistant finish, keeping your table looking new.

features.title: Sturdy design handles heavy use
features.text: Built with sturdy materials, our design confidently supports heavier items, giving you dependable durability that holds up beautifully to everyday use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
